purpose: A Numen-lane branch-and-fold fixture dramatizing a Matriarch Tree recall audience as wondrous, embodied, costly ecological infrastructure in a disconnected Airawa network.

local_awareness_summary.text: The archive tender is an unnamed six-limbed Airawa worker with load-bearing clawed upper arms, precise blunt lower hands, grasping taloned feet, memory-bearing cellular symbionts, and practical knowledge of Shale-Root's shallow archive procedure.
The scene begins during routine preparation for an eclipse-ingress recall audience, before a contaminated cadence appears and the present hillside starts to fail.

The tender can stage offerings, negotiate with ecological witnesses, touch or close shallow archive tissue, spend route resources, and carry a bounded embodied echo; she cannot command deep tree memory or identify the contaminant without evidence.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains the archive tender's embodied position inside one shallow root gallery. Choices use Airawa anchoring, lower-hand craft, contract objects, witness negotiation, bodily memory, and consent signals.
Tonal mode is ritual quiet with dry workplace wit, sensory wonder, and bounded ecological dread. Routine work and colleague familiarity arrive before contamination pressure.

authority_boundaries.text: The Matriarch Tree owns archive permeability and selective emphasis. The tender owns preparation, petition, embodied participation, and the decision to accept, limit, defer, or personally carry an output.

Fungal, courier, Airawa, and tree traces corroborate different channels. No single witness supplies an objective view, and the Biological Memetic Engine pressure remains an unresolved contaminant rather than a speaking omniscient antagonist.

object_custody.text: The mineral bowl, root cups, contract tokens, shed Airawa scale, threadwing vane, fungal witness strand, salt cup, shallow aperture, and quarantine ring have visible custody and affect branch state.

required_semantics.text: The recall must remain a multispecies biological reconstruction that can be wondrous, biased, refused, exhausted, or infected.
Every route must preserve the tradeoff among immediate warning, legal standing, archive safety, route light, bodily boundary, and Matriarch Tree consent.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not turn the Matriarch Tree into an infallible deity, passive database, human elder in bark, or universal planetary mind.
Do not canonize the contaminant's origin, make one branch the canonical outcome, or let urgency authorize unbounded deep archive access.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Three choice layers fold through routine preparation and a contaminated recall mismatch, then select one of eight state-gated endings.

branches.actor_intent: Feed the root cups enough stored sugar and minerals to widen shallow archive access.
state_basis: Recall consumes stored energy.
Lantern-route sugar is a civic resource during eclipse.
reviewed_consequences: Raises archive_energy and tree_consent while lowering route_light; later prose shows dimmed travel infrastructure, and full recall reads both resources.

branches.actor_intent: Use a paid threadwing vane trace to strengthen route provenance.
state_basis: Threadwing vanes carry memory residues and route reputation.
Couriers are paid in salt and reliable route light.
reviewed_consequences: Raises witness_integrity while lowering route_light; later folds and the full-recall gate read both.

branches.actor_intent: Add a living Airawa comparison trace at the cost of a thinner personal memory boundary.
state_basis: Airawa cells carry mutable memory symbionts.
A recall audience can propagate compatible fragments through petitioners.
reviewed_consequences: Raises witness_integrity and tree_consent while lowering tender_boundary; the living-carrier ending reads the bodily cost.

branches.actor_intent: Ask the candle road to taste the fungal witness before it reaches archive tissue.
state_basis: Candle roads remember sickness and maintain quarantine pockets.
Their visible beads can signal contamination.
reviewed_consequences: Lowers contamination_risk while raising witness_integrity and warning_clarity and lowering route_light; later folds and multiple endings read these changes.

branches.actor_intent: Use the tender's own symbionts to separate the useful disaster reflex from the authored cadence.
state_basis: Recall is embodied through compatible memory symbionts.
The tender can touch shallow archive tissue but does not control deep organs.
reviewed_consequences: Raises warning_clarity and tree_consent while sharply lowering tender_boundary and raising contamination_risk; the folded prose and living-carrier gate expose both benefit and danger.

branches.actor_intent: Invite the threadwing to compare the suspect trace through a living circuit it may refuse.
state_basis: Threadwings read chemical, static, pressure, and memory residues.
They retain agency over message and route.
reviewed_consequences: Raises witness_integrity and warning_clarity while lowering route_light; a visible threadwing accusation and the full-recall gate use the result.

branches.actor_intent: Give the candle road custody of the suspect strand and continue with cleaner but thinner evidence.
state_basis: Candle roads can raise quarantine rings and remember custody.
A missing witness reduces completeness while a legible refusal can preserve standing.
reviewed_consequences: Lowers contamination_risk and witness_integrity while raising warning_clarity, legal_standing, and tree_consent; bounded-warning and tree-authority routes read the change.

branches.actor_intent: Withdraw the Airawa claim and let the Matriarch Tree decide what its archive may expose.
state_basis: The tree owns archive permeability and may refuse access.
Tree survival and community legal needs can diverge.
reviewed_consequences: Raises tree_consent and warning_clarity while lowering archive_energy and legal_standing; the tree-authority ending can succeed while producing a less invocable public claim.

branches.actor_intent: Spend the remaining archive reserve for a complete, corroborated collapse reconstruction.
state_basis: Success requires energy, witness integrity, tolerable contamination, and at least one remaining route-light unit.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a legally strong multispecies recall or to an over-opened contaminated archive; route_light changes the success aftermath.

branches.actor_intent: Close the archive and act only on the smallest warning the witnesses support.
state_basis: Success requires clear warning content, adequate legal standing, and tolerable contamination.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a repeated multispecies evacuation warning or to a fragmented warning other ecological parties will not carry.

branches.actor_intent: Accept the Matriarch Tree as boundary owner and follow its chosen illuminated route.
state_basis: Success requires strong tree consent and tolerable contamination.
Tree authority does not guarantee Airawa legal standing or altruistic emphasis.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a coherent tree-led evacuation with explicit future debt or to a refusal that saves the deep archive while exposing the route.

branches.actor_intent: Carry the unsettled route reflex into the world as a living, revisable witness.
state_basis: Success requires enough personal boundary, warning clarity, and contamination control for the tender to remain an accountable carrier.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to embodied route guidance that remains open to correction or to memory bleed that makes the tender the new quarantined channel.

Checked the vault index and nineteen relevant Zyphos notes; the only durable backfill is the authored Recall Audiences section in Matriarch Trees. Shale-Root and every ending remain fixture-local.

Thirteen visual anchors, sixteen branch or ending modifiers, stable visible-character refs, and an embedded draft scene map remain; a hand-built blockout is required before high-consistency multi-angle website art.

Spatial cohesion review: accepted. Scores: layout cohesion 5/5, sightlines 5/5, body affordance 5/5, movement and access 5/5, object-system geometry 5/5, branch spatial state 5/5. The stable frame is deep archive wall to the right, outer ledge to the left, floor fungal lane, central salt perch, overhead lantern route, and visible uphill fracture; all actions use reachable Airawa limbs or declared ecological routes.
